name: Zero Interest Loan for Upgrades
description: Up to $10,000 zero-interest loan for heat pump water heaters, heat pump heating/AC, and electrical panel upgrades; no money down, no credit check, 2-5 year term
fullDescription: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) offers zero-interest financing to help its customers electrify their homes without upfront costs, with convenient repayment through monthly utility bills.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $10,000 zero-interest loan
- No money down, no fees, no credit check
- Choose a 2 to 5 year repayment term
- Covers heat pump water heaters
- Covers heat pump HVAC systems
- Covers electrical panel upgrades (when part of a heat pump project)
- Repayment on monthly electric bill
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a WestLight Energy residential customer, own the home, and have the PG&E bill in your name
2. Have no past-due balance on your last three PG&E bills
3. Get a quote from a WestLight Energy loan-approved contractor
4. Apply online with the quote (reviewed within five business days) and sign the loan agreement before installation
5. Complete installation; WestLight Energy pays the contractor
6. Loan payments added to monthly electric bill
keywords: zero interest loan, financing, WestLight Energy, Peninsula Clean Energy, PCE, San Mateo, heat pump, electrification, no money down
